title: Trading Glossary | PropLogAI Glossary
description: 35 essential trading terms explained for prop firm traders. From FOMO to funded accounts — learn the vocabulary that makes you a better trader.
h1: Every term a trader needs to know.

title: FOMO (Fear of Missing Out) | PropLogAI Glossary
description: The anxiety-driven urge to enter a trade because the market is moving without you, often leading to impulsive entries outside your trading plan.

title: Revenge Trading | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A post-loss pattern where recovering the lost money becomes the purpose of the next decision and the trader changes or ignores part of the written plan.

title: Tilt | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A state of emotional frustration where a trader abandons rational decision-making, often triggered by a string of losses or a single large loss.

title: Confirmation Bias | PropLogAI Glossary
description: The tendency to seek out information that supports your existing trade idea while ignoring evidence that contradicts it.

title: Loss Aversion | PropLogAI Glossary
description: The tendency for a loss to affect a decision more strongly than an equivalent gain in many situations.

title: Overconfidence | PropLogAI Glossary
description: An inflated belief in your trading ability, often following a winning streak, leading to increased risk-taking and abandonment of risk rules.

title: Drawdown | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Drawdown is the amount an account falls from an earlier high to a later value. A prop firm drawdown limit is a separate rule that sets an official account floor.

title: Position Sizing | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Determining how many lots or contracts to trade based on your account size, risk tolerance, and distance to your stop loss.

title: Risk-Reward Ratio | PropLogAI Glossary
description: The comparison between how much you stand to lose (risk) versus how much you stand to gain (reward) on a trade, expressed as a ratio like 1:2 or 1:3.

title: Stop Loss | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A predetermined price level at which you exit a losing trade to limit your downside, placed before or immediately after entering the trade.

title: Risk Per Trade | PropLogAI Glossary
description: The maximum planned loss for one trade, stated as money, account percentage, or risk units if the stop is reached.

title: Win Rate | PropLogAI Glossary
description: The percentage of your trades that close in profit, calculated as winning trades divided by total trades.

title: Profit Factor | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Total gross profit divided by the absolute value of total gross loss for a defined set of closed trades.

title: Expectancy | PropLogAI Glossary
description: The average result per trade in a defined historical sample, calculated from win rate, loss rate, average win, and average loss.

title: Sharpe Ratio | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A risk-adjusted-return measure that compares average return above a chosen baseline with the variation of those returns.

title: Average Win vs Average Loss | PropLogAI Glossary
description: The comparison between the average dollar amount of your winning trades versus your losing trades, revealing whether your winners outsize your losers.

title: Equity Curve | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A graph of cumulative account balance or equity across time or trade order, showing gains, losses, flat periods, and drawdowns.

title: Trading Plan | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A comprehensive written document defining your strategy, risk rules, entry/exit criteria, and session schedule — your complete rulebook for trading.

title: Setup Compliance | PropLogAI Glossary
description: The degree to which a trade matches your predefined setup criteria — whether you followed your own rules for entry, stop loss, and target.

title: Overtrading | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A departure from a trader’s written process in which trade frequency, timing, size, or setup quality changes because of pressure, impulse, or recent results.

title: Pre-Market Routine | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A structured preparation process completed before trading begins, including market analysis, level marking, news checks, and mental readiness assessment.

title: Trade Management | PropLogAI Glossary
description: The decisions you make after entering a trade — adjusting stops, scaling in or out, trailing stops, or closing early based on changing market conditions.

title: Rule-Based Trading | PropLogAI Glossary
description: An approach where every trading decision — entries, exits, sizing, and session management — follows predefined written rules rather than subjective judgment.

title: Prop Firm Challenge | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A rules-based evaluation, often on a simulated account, that a trader must complete to qualify for the firm’s next account stage.

title: Funded Account | PropLogAI Glossary
description: An account stage offered under a prop firm agreement after eligibility conditions are met; it may use simulated or live-market capital depending on the firm.

title: Overall Drawdown Limit | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A program rule that sets the lowest permitted account value, using a fixed or moving reference defined by the firm.

title: Profit Target | PropLogAI Glossary
description: The net-profit objective a named prop firm program requires for a particular evaluation phase.

title: Consistency Rule | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A consistency rule checks whether too much of your total profit came from one day or one trade. Your firm decides the formula, limit, and what happens when you are over it.

title: Daily Drawdown Limit | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A prop firm rule that sets the lowest permitted account value during a defined trading day.

title: Trading Journal | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A structured record of trade context, plan, execution, result, rule compliance, emotions, screenshots, and review notes used to compare decisions over time.

title: Trade Review | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A structured analysis of past trades to identify patterns, mistakes, and strengths — typically done daily, weekly, or monthly to drive continuous improvement.

title: Emotion Tracking | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Emotion tracking means recording a simple feeling tag beside a trade so you can review whether the feeling appeared near a change in your trading decisions.

title: Pattern Recognition | PropLogAI Glossary
description: The ability to identify recurring behaviors, habits, and tendencies in your own trading by analyzing journal data over time.

title: Performance Report | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A comprehensive analysis of your trading over a defined period, covering statistics, patterns, strengths, weaknesses, and actionable recommendations.

title: AI Trading Coach | PropLogAI Glossary
description: An AI system that analyzes your trading journal data to provide personalized performance coaching — identifying patterns, weaknesses, and behavioral improvements.
